title: Write Testbench for Branch Unit
statement: Write a testbench for a branch condition unit that checks negative and zero flags. The testbench should apply representative values and verify the taken output. It should help catch logic errors in branch evaluation.
behavior: Apply signed values around zero and negative boundaries.
Verify taken matches the expected branch decision.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not alter the DUT module in the testbench.
hint: Cover both zero, negative, and positive cases.
